jobs.title: Lead Corporate Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for 2 Corporate Strategy Director's for our Corporate Strategy- Integrated & Platforms and SMB team and help shape the future of global commerce.

We are growing our Corporate Strategy team and looking for exceptional talent across multiple levels. You'll join a diverse, international group of strategists who are passionate about payments and fintech. We are a team of naturally curious people who love exploring new ideas, challenging assumptions, and debating different viewpoints to arrive at the best outcomes. Equally important, we are deeply collaborative, always willing to lend a hand, share perspectives, and help each other grow and succeed.

What you'll own
- Own and lead strategic initiatives that unlock new growth opportunities and strengthen Global Payments’ competitive position in the payments and financial technology industry.
- Own the development and execution of merchant propositions across key segments, creating differentiated solutions that deliver greater value for clients and accelerate business performance.
- Lead and oversee high-profile, cross-functional projects with product/commercial implications, translating strategic ideas into measurable outcomes while ensuring successful execution and stakeholder alignment.
- Play a leading role in shaping Global Payments’ M&A strategy by identifying opportunities that expand capabilities, enter new markets, and create long-term value.
- Own strategic market assessments and identify emerging trends, client needs, and industry shifts, transforming insights into actionable strategies that position the business for future success.
- Develop and deliver compelling recommendations and executive-level materials that influence decision-making and guide strategic priorities with senior leaders and the Board.
- Lead and influence senior stakeholder relationships across business units, product, technology, finance, sales, and external partners to drive alignment, accelerate execution, and remove barriers to delivery.
- Champion innovation by leading the evaluation of new products, partnerships, and business models, helping shape the future of payments and commerce.

What you'll bring
- 6-10 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, corporate strategy, private equity, or a strategy focused role within a financial institution
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with advanced capabilities in Excel and PowerPoint
- Demonstrated track record of leading complex strategic initiatives and delivering measurable business outcomes in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
- Exceptional communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, including experience preparing materials for C-suite leaders and Boards of Directors.
- Deep interest in payments, financial technology, software, commerce, and emerging technology trends, with the ability to identify and capitalize on new growth opportunities.
- Proven ability to influence stakeholders and build credibility across a complex organization.
- A highly proactive, ownership-oriented leadership style, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results.
- Demonstrated ability to coach and develop junior team members across both hard skills (e.g., strategic analysis, business model development) and soft skills (e.g., stakeholder management, executive communication)

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

jobs.title: Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
Job Description
This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must be a US Citizen or valid Green Card Holder.

This position is hybrid 3 days per week in the following office locations: Cincinnati, OH

Ready to take your career global?
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Transformation Lead to join our ever-evolving Technology Strategy and Transformation Office team and help shape the future of global commerce.

What you’ll own
- Lead planning and execution of complex integration and separation programs across Technology to ensure successful delivery from Day 1 readiness through transition, stabilization, and steady-state operations.
- Develop and drive end-to-end integration and separation workplans, including Day 1 and 30/60/90 day execution, synergy realization, Transition Service Agreement (TSA) design, transition, and exit with clear scope, timelines, and accountabilities.
- Establish and lead program governance, including steering committees, RAID management, change control, executive decision forums, and cross-functional dependency management to ensure timely issue resolution and alignment.
- Oversee execution, coordinating cutovers, stabilization activities, and business readiness to maintain operational continuity, customer experience, and regulatory compliance.
- Direct TSA performance management, including service delivery monitoring, SLA adherence, issue remediation, billing coordination, accruals, invoicing, and financial true-ups in partnership with Finance and functional leaders.
- Drive value realization by building, tracking, and reporting business cases, synergies, TSA economics, KPIs, OKRs, and variance analyses, providing actionable insights to senior leadership.
- Identify and mitigate program risks.  Raise and resolve issues, working collaboratively across teams; act as an integrator across stakeholders, surfacing trade-offs and mitigation options.

What you’ll bring
- Bachelor’s degree or Master’s Degree, plus 8-10+ years of relevant experience in Technology Transformation, Corporate Strategy, Management Consulting, Finance, PMO, M&A integration/divestitures, or a related cross-functional role.
- Experience in working cross functionally with internal and external vendors/partners
- Knowledge of payments/fintech, technology-enabled services, or complex global operations is advantageous

It’s a bonus if you have
- Think like a client: We care deeply about our clients' success. We ask, listen and learn — curious to understand first. Our passion drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
- Act like an owner: We take accountability — working at pace to own our outcomes. We empower each other to make decisions. We’re innovative — always finding better ways to deliver impact.
- Win as one team: We value personal connections — moving forward together with clarity. We build inclusive and global teams — embracing different perspectives and ideas. It’s always ‘we,’ never ‘me.’ We’re determined to succeed together.

About the team
Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.

You will have an opportunity to learn about many teams, systems, and processes that span across functional areas and platforms; help document and improve playbooks, templates, and lessons learned.

What makes a Globalpayer?
Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

jobs.title: Business & Strategy Associate
jobs.description:
Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. Are you a proactive, analytical and collaborative problem-solver with experience in strategy, either through a top management consultancy, or through an internal strategy role? Looking for an exciting and highly rewarding new career opportunity? We’re looking for a Business and Strategy professional to become a core member of our International Strategy team, to shape and drive the strategy and execution priorities of our business and help shape the future of global commerce.

What You’ll Own

Our team defines and executes what the business needs most, so can be varied across functions and disciplines depending on the project. We provide thought-leadership and translate it to practical objectives and plans which we execute for the business. Examples of work you will own and drive include:
- Driving and supporting discreet projects to support the strategy. Full range of the project life-cycle from scope, initiate and execute strategic projects derived from the analysis
- Owning and delivering aspects of periodic strategy refreshes for the International Platforms business.
- Monitoring and analysing trends shaping the payments ecosystem, including changes in customer behaviour, technology, regulation, payment methods, distribution models, and industry economics.
- Assessing the strategic implications of market movements for the company’s products, customers, partnerships, and geographic footprint.
- Developing market expansion plans and requirements.
- Identifying emerging opportunities and risks, distinguishing structural changes from short-term market developments.
- Producing and presenting concise, decision-oriented reports and presentations for senior leadership.

What You’ll Bring
- Proven experience in strategy and project-based business change delivery work
- Extreme curiosity to understand and think through the underlying challenges of the business and what needs to change to solve them
- Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify opportunities and turn them into discreet projects
- Experience of quantitative market research and knowledge of ISV-led payments and B2B2C business models
- The ability to navigate change with confidence and adapt quickly in an evolving global environment
- A bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education, training and experience

About The Team

Our Strategy team for Platforms, International is responsible for the growth of our Platforms business outside of North America and Canada. The team is HQ'd out of London with a significant presence in Australia covering the needs of the ANZ organisation. This is a hybrid role based in London with responsibilities primarily within Europe, however as needs arise we support projects in ANZ too.
